_about: Hosts a Study Abroad fact or proposal source may come from: government bodies, embassies, and the universities own domains. Subdomains count; lookalikes do not. Never add a provider, agent, coaching or listing site. Exception, agreed 2026-10-31: a statutory (public-law) health insurer may be listed for its own statutory contribution or rate page only - never for a marketing or product page. `tk.de` is that case (the German health-insurance guide cites TK's own published contribution table). Added 2026-10-30 from the hosts the existing rows cite, judged by domain name; the owner should confirm.
